sections.heading: style-116 · Blueprint Drafting Animation — "An idea becomes a connected system" (3 s, silent)

children.value: Renderers: SVG (all geometry, hatching, masks), with SVG text in a monospace face. Motion: one paused GSAP timeline (

) plus DrawSVGPlugin. 1280x720 at 30 fps. Field is #1B3ED2 (stationary) and lines are #FFFFFF (contrast 7.88).
All geometry comes from the
object, and the dimension labels are computed from it.

rows.Beat: Minor and major grid fade in. The heading "AN IDEA BECOMES / A CONNECTED SYSTEM" fades in from 0.10 to 0.50.
The idea part's outlines draw at 2.5 px: the bulb circle Ø180, the inner wall and the 70×54 base.
The hidden filament (dashed 8 6, 1.5 px) is revealed by a drawSVG mask over the already-dashed path.
Hatch clip rects wipe across the bulb's wall section and the base. The FIG.1 caption appears.
Three connector arrows draw out from the idea. Each head switches on at the moment its shaft finishes (1.40, 1.48, 1.56).
Block frames INPUT, CORE, LINK and OUTPUT draw in, then their header hatching wipes in. Each label appears after its frame is complete.
Dashed hidden links join the blocks into a system.
dim-1 to dim-4: extension lines draw, then each shaft draws from its centre out to both ends. Both heads switch on together at 1.90, 2.05, 2.20 and 2.35, and each label follows 0.05 s later.
The title block frame draws, then its text appears.
